dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are a shrine maiden's duties?

dialogues.speaker: Miyuki
dialogues.text: Our duties are obviously to obey the commands of Lady Guuji Yae!

dialogues.speaker: Miyuki
dialogues.text: I will do my best to complete any instructions Lady Yae gives me, just as I did in Tatarasuna. I won't ever let her down.
